originality.rationale: Janson/Simion-Schmidt already give the composition representation and enumeration, and Baril and Barcucci et al. provide related Gray codes; neither these inspected statements nor the closest indexed graph-geometry results supplies the derived exact position-adjacent induced graph metric, binomial degree spectrum and edge count for Av(231,321). The premise is explicitly treated as known; novelty is limited to the complete induced graph geometry. A genuinely equivalent earlier East-graph metric is the principal residual historical risk.
residual_risks: The facilitated-hypercube metric may have been studied under a different graph name and could imply this specific class via the known composition representation.
Some earlier permutation Gray-code work may contain an implicit equivalent construction; the present Hamilton-path component is not asserted novel by itself.
Absent independent expert review, historical priority and subtle implementation mistakes cannot be entirely excluded.

value.rationale: Exact shortest-path diameter and local-mobility distribution on an exponentially large natural restricted permutation configuration space are concrete structural invariants for constrained adjacent-swap Gray codes and reconfiguration. The induced graph has linear diameter 2n-3 and just two low-mobility leaves despite 2^(n-1) states; these properties are not simply the known 2^(n-1) class count. The result is a motivated full-family graph classification, not an arbitrary small numerical slice.
